rejected.done_when:
All of the following hold:
- Each card in scope has had its action performed (kept active, frozen, or closed with the right reason) and confirmed, or the customer was told what blocks it. Cards in scope are those the customer asked to close, those with filed disputes, and PIN-locked cards the customer agreed to close after the investigation. With several cards, each card was handled on its own.
- A card blocked by pending transactions was not closed. The customer was told it can be closed once the transactions settle (no settlement time promised). It stays frozen if frozen, or was frozen if the customer agreed.
- A PIN-locked card with disputed fraud was closed exactly once.
- A PIN-locked card with no money taken was closed (reason fraud_suspected) only after the customer chose closure, with no dispute filed.
- A card with a pending refund was closed only after the customer acknowledged in writing that the refund goes to the linked checking account. Otherwise the customer was told to wait for the refund to process.
- For a PIN-locked card, the customer has been told whether any money was taken.
- Disputes that were not filed set no card action.
- A card with a fraud alert and a filed fraud dispute was closed without its alert being cleared.
- A card the customer found again was not closed.
- For each closed card, one of these is true: a replacement was ordered to the confirmed address (on file or alternate) with the correct tier fees and timeframe; the customer declined one; or the customer was told when one can be ordered (the Entry 48-hour wait counted from the recorded closure time, including after accepting the excess fee; or the tier limit, with the age-out date when the customer chose to wait).
- Lost and stolen cards have been handed to the cross-product check (once per conversation).

steps.if: customer is verified
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Read all cards on the account: statuses, issue_reason, date_issued.
steps.if: customer is verified
steps.quote: Retrieve all cards for the account

steps.do: Get the current time for the account age, 12-month window and waiting period.
steps.quote: Check the date_issued field and count cards issued within the last 12 months

steps.do: Check: account_type is checking; status OPEN; open at least 3 business days (date_opened, excluding weekends); no ACTIVE card on the account; no PENDING card; balance at least $25; customer at least 18 (DOB); address on file is a valid US domestic address. If any check fails, tell the customer what must be resolved and do not order.
steps.quote: Account status must be OPEN

basis.quote: The account must be a checking account (account_type must be 'checking')
Account must have been open for at least 3 business days (excluding weekends)
Customer cannot have more than 1 active debit cards per checking account
Account must have a minimum balance of $25 (to cover potential fees)
Customer must be at least 18 years old (verify using date_of_birth)
Customer cannot have a pending debit card order for the same account (check debit_cards table for PENDING status)
Customer's address on file must be a valid US domestic address (international shipping is not available)

steps.do: Count replacement cards (issue_reason lost, stolen, fraud or damaged) issued in the last 12 months; new_account, first_card, expired, upgrade and bank_reissue do not count. Entry: max 2, and a 48-hour wait after the card closure before ordering; if over the limit, wait or pay a $25 excess fee. Mid: max 3, no wait; if over, wait or pay $15. Premium: max 5, no wait; if over, must wait (no fee option). Elite: unlimited, no wait. If the customer must wait, tell them when they can order and stop.
steps.quote: Cards with issue_reason of 'new_account', 'first_card', 'expired', 'upgrade', or 'bank_reissue' do NOT count toward the replacement limit.

basis.quote: Look for cards with issue_reason of 'lost', 'stolen', 'fraud', or 'damaged'
48-hour waiting period after card closure before a replacement can be ordered
If customer has exceeded the 2-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out of the 12-month window, OR pay a $25 excess replacement fee
If customer has exceeded the 3-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out, OR pay a $15 excess replacement fee
If customer has exceeded the 5-card limit, they must wait until oldest replacement ages out (no fee option - must wait)
Unlimited replacement cards
No waiting period - can order immediately after closure

steps.do: Offer only the delivery options the tier allows, with their fees and times. Entry: STANDARD only, $0. Mid: STANDARD $0 or EXPEDITED $15. Premium: STANDARD $0, EXPEDITED $0, RUSH $35. Elite: STANDARD, EXPEDITED and RUSH all $0. Times: STANDARD 7-10, EXPEDITED 3-5, RUSH 1-2 business days. Ask the customer to choose.
steps.quote: Ask customer for preferred delivery option (STANDARD, EXPEDITED, or RUSH) and explain fees.

basis.quote: Standard shipping only (no expedited option available) - delivery_fee: $0
Standard (delivery_fee: $0) or expedited shipping available (delivery_fee: $15)
Free expedited shipping on all replacements (delivery_fee: $0 for both STANDARD and EXPEDITED)
Rush shipping available (delivery_fee: $35)
Complimentary shipping on all replacements (delivery_fee: $0 for STANDARD, EXPEDITED, and RUSH)
STANDARD: Free shipping, arrives in 7-10 business days
EXPEDITED: $15 fee, arrives in 3-5 business days
RUSH: $35 fee, arrives in 1-2 business days, fees may vary based on account tier.

steps.do: Offer the designs with the tier's fees and ask the customer to choose. CLASSIC is $0 for every tier. PREMIUM is $10 for Entry and Mid, $0 for Premium and Elite. CUSTOM is $25 for Entry and Mid, $15 for Premium, $0 for Elite.
steps.quote: Ask customer for preferred card design (CLASSIC, PREMIUM, or CUSTOM) and explain fees.

basis.quote: CLASSIC design: design_fee $0
PREMIUM design (metallic silver): design_fee $10
CUSTOM design (uploaded image): design_fee $25
PREMIUM design (metallic silver): design_fee $0 (complimentary)
CUSTOM design (uploaded image): design_fee $15 (discounted from $25)
CUSTOM design (uploaded image): design_fee $0 (complimentary)

steps.do: Confirm the address the customer wants the card mailed to. It may differ from the home address.
steps.quote: Confirm the address that the customer would like to mail the card to.

steps.do: Tell the customer the total fees (delivery + design + any excess fee) that will be deducted from the checking account before ordering. If the balance cannot cover them, the order will fail.
steps.quote: Always inform the customer that the fee will be deducted from their checking account balance before placing the order.

basis.quote: If the account has insufficient funds for delivery or design fees, the order will fail

steps.do: Unlock and call order_debit_card_5739. On an error reply, tell the customer what it says must be resolved (for example, an existing active card, a balance below $25, insufficient funds).

args.excess_replacement_fee: $25 (Entry) or $15 (Mid) only if over the limit and the customer chose to pay; otherwise 0
